description: Find the websites of one to five Norwegian companies and the platform each runs on, such as Shopify or WooCommerce. Checks the registered website, the domain of the registered email and domains guessed from the company name, and confirms ownership by finding the organisation number or full company name on the site. For each company returns the website with its source, evidence and confidence (or null); the site platform: shopify_theme, shopify_headless or shopify_headless_likely with the theme, another store platform such as woocommerce, magento, nopcommerce, mystore or 24nettbutikk, a site builder or CMS such as wix, squarespace, webflow, wordpress, custompublish or odoo, a Norwegian store platform such as retailhub, a headless content platform (sanity, contentful), nextjs for other custom builds, or unknown with the generator tag; and every address checked. site.shopify is true for any Shopify storefront. Some sites block automated requests and read as unreachable. Takes up to about 15 seconds.

organizationNumbers.description: One to five organisation numbers, such as one search page split up.

items.description: Nine-digit Norwegian organisation number, such as 923609016.

name: find_norwegian_company_websites
title: Find Norwegian company websites
